hits.title: RIVALS FPS: Online Shooter
hits.description:
💥Welcome to the world of "RIVALS FPS: Online Shooter" — a new free multiplayer online shooter where fun battles, cool guns, and a real arena of clashes await you!

🎮 The game is inspired by top shooters like Star Wars Battlefront and Battlefield. Here you can dive into dynamic online battles, team up with friends, and show your shooting skills in the arena.

⚙️ Features:
- Online multiplayer with friends
- First-person shooter
- Bright 3D graphics in a colorful style
- Lots of interesting maps
- Different game modes and leaderboards
- Play for free right in the browser from your mobile phone or computer

Fight, upgrade, change weapons and take rewards in epic online battles!
hits.howToPlayText:
To start a game, create a map or join other players.

The controls are the same as in many top shooters.

On PC:
- Movement - WASD
- Camera rotation - Using the mouse
- Jump - Space
- Crouch - C
- Interact with objects - E

On mobile:
- Movement - Virtual joystick on the left
- Camera rotation - Swipes on the right side of the screen
- Jump, reload using virtual buttons
